CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/promotion.py:1278
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:650 and reckon/crew/promotion.py:1278 now carry the current name and reckon/run_record.py:33 keeps only the deliberate retired-key constant, so the plan's stated intent that the extractor stop naming the retired field is met.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the arms recorded at baseline_suite and after_suite recompute to 33 and 25 failures with an empty added-id set, and the fragment's table at line 50 matches, but no ruff log exists and the head arm runs at efd409b03 rather than the reviewed head, both of which a reader must take on trust.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the two commits touch only docs/evidence/fragments/additional-work-is-a-section/every-derived-manifest-carries-the-outside-scope-field.html, reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/run_record.py and the three test files, each declared or widened in the run's resume advice.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_every_derived_manifest_carries_the_outside_scope_field.py:121 and :129 redden if either retired name returns, and reckon/crew/promotion.py:1278 raises AttributeError if the rename regresses, but the inherited assertion at tests/test_routing_evidence_fields.py:196 cannot fail.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: the two added cases follow the repository's hasattr idiom (used in 20 test files) and reckon/ledger.py:650 keeps the module's existing docstring shape, with no plan label or version suffix in any added name.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change removes a duplicated reader rather than adding one — reckon/run_record.py now has a single mapping, normalize_outside_scope_paths — and a search for an owner of a module-API rename guard found only tests/test_old_names_resolve.py, which owns catalogue alias resolution and not this capability.
FINDING reckon/crew/reports.py:105 non-blocking: at the reviewed head this comment still lists `follow_ons` among the prose list fields, so the earlier stale-name finding is unaddressed at the revision this record names; the fix lives only in d2f4a09b8, a child of the reviewed head this record does not cover and the manifest's commits list does not name.
FINDING tests/test_routing_evidence_fields.py:196 non-blocking: the assertion compares the extractor's result against the same list the test passed in, so it holds for any implementation that returns its input and cannot redden if path extraction regresses; it is inherited through the rename rather than added here.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/additional-work-is-a-section/every-derived-manifest-carries-the-outside-scope-field.html:50 non-blocking: the arms table records the failure delta but no ruff log, so the done-when's ruff clause rests on the manifest's self-reported counts with nothing a reader can open.
